# Stamp each 4-connected component of a selected color, bottom-aligning that component's bbox.
from collections import deque

def stamp_components(panel_bottom,obj,left,selected,edge):
    h,w=len(obj),len(obj[0]); seen=set()
    comps=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if obj[y][x]!=selected or (y,x) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(y,x)]); seen.add((y,x)); cells=[]
            while q:
                yy,xx=q.popleft(); cells.append((yy,xx))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p=(yy+dy,xx+dx)
                    if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and obj[p[0]][p[1]]==selected:
                        seen.add(p); q.append(p)
            comps.append(cells)
    for cells in comps:
        maxy=max(y for y,x in cells); miny=min(y for y,x in cells); minx=min(x for y,x in cells)
        top=panel_bottom-(maxy-miny)
        for y,x in cells:
            g[top+(y-miny)][left+x]=edge

# rebuild panels baseline and add correct connected-component transforms
g=[[1]*W for _ in range(H)]
for y,row in enumerate(objA): g[2+y][17:22]=row
for r in (4,5):
    for c in (13,14): g[r][c]=8
for y,row in enumerate(objB): g[7+y][3:12]=row
for r in range(14,19): g[r]=[2]*W; g[r][0]=g[r][23]=8
for r in range(20,25): g[r]=[4]*W; g[r][0]=g[r][23]=2
for r in range(26,30): g[r]=[8]*W; g[r][0]=g[r][23]=6
stamp_components(18,objA,17,2,8)
stamp_components(24,objA,17,4,2)
stamp_components(24,objB,3,4,2)
stamp_components(29,objB,3,8,6)
stamp_components(29,[[8,8],[8,8]],13,8,6)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
